Burdick plans to retire from the board, with experienced healthcare executive Paul J. Diaz joining as a new director. items.title: Why Centene (CNC) Shares Are Sliding Today
items.summary: Shares of health coverage company Centene (NYSE:CNC) fell 5.1% in the morning session after a significant decline in membership appeared to overshadow an otherwise strong second-quarter earnings report where the company beat expectations and raised its full-year profit forecast. Centene's adjusted earnings per share of $2.51 and revenue of $53.58 billion both significantly surpassed analyst estimates.
